title: Menelai Sphaericorum Libri III — Digital Scriptorium Sources Manifest
copyright_policy: 100% Public-Domain Primary Witnesses Only (pre-1929). Zero reliance on post-1930 copyrighted editions or translations (explicitly excluding Krause 1936 and Rashed & Papadopoulos 2017). English translation authored 100% originally from multimodal visual inspection of Halley (1758) Latin and Heiberg (1898) Greek scans.

sources.author: Menelaus of Alexandria; Edmond Halley (ed.); George Costard (pref.)
sources.title: Menelai Sphaericorum Libri III. Quos olim, collatis MSS. Hebraeis & Arabicis, Typis exprimendos curavit Vir Cl. Ed. Halleius LL.D. R.S.S. Praefationem addidit G. Costard, A.M.
sources.language: Latin (with Hebrew & Arabic philological glosses and Greek point labels)
sources.scan_offset_note: scan_page = printed_page + 16 (Title = scan 7; Costard Preface [i]–[viii] = scans 9–16; Book I pp. 1–47 = scans 17–63; Book II pp. 48–79 = scans 64–95; Book III pp. 80–112 = scans 96–128)

sources.author: Claudius Ptolemy; Johan Ludvig Heiberg (ed.)
sources.title: Claudii Ptolemaei Opera quae exstant omnia, Vol. I: Syntaxis Mathematica, Pars I (Libros I–VI continens)
sources.place: Lipsiae (Leipzig): In aedibus B. G. Teubneri
sources.locus_note: Book I, Ch. 13 (Προλαμβανόμενα εἰς τὰς σφαιρικὰς δείξεις), pp. 68–76 (scans 78–86): oldest surviving Greek proof of Planar & Spherical Menelaus in chords of double arcs

sources.author: Axel Anthon Björnbo
sources.title: Studien über Menelaos' Sphärik. Beiträge zur Geschichte der Sphärik und Trigonometrie der Griechen (Abhandlungen zur Geschichte der mathematischen Wissenschaften, XIV. Heft)
sources.place: Leipzig: Druck und Verlag von B. G. Teubner
sources.locus_note: Comprehensive stemmatic, structural, and proposition-by-proposition philological analysis comparing Halley (1758), Maurolico (1558), Mersenne (1644), Ptolemy, Theon, and Pappus

sources.author: Francesco Maurolico (Franciscus Maurolycus)
sources.title: Theodosii Sphaericorum Elementorum Libri III. Ex traditione Maurolyci Messanensis Mathematici. Menelai Sphaericorum Lib. III. Ex traditione eiusdem.
sources.locus_note: First printed Renaissance synthesis/reconstruction of Menelaus's Sphaerica (augmented with Maurolico's interpolations; critically collated in Costard 1758 pp. v–vii and Björnbo 1902)

sources.author: Pappus of Alexandria; Friedrich Hultsch (ed.)
sources.title: Pappi Alexandrini Collectionis quae supersunt, Vol. II (Librorum VI et VII reliquias continens)
sources.locus_note: Book VI astronomical commentary preserving Greek testimonies to Menelaus's Sphaerica (including the appellation Μενέλαος ὁ Ἀλεξανδρεύς and Book II rising-time theorems)
